ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central fluke area (approx. 75% total area) is characterized by a solid black contiguous mass. High-intensity white fields are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Right distal white zone contains high-frequency vertical dark lineaments. Left distal white zone contains sparse dark mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated interior V-shaped notch angle of approximately 50-55 degrees; depth is approx. 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations. Notable large-scale structural discontinuity (jagged indentation) on the distal upper edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves originating from the median notch and tapering to acute lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, brownish-white calcified protrusions (barnacles) located on the lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel vertical dark rake marks breaking the white pigmentation on the distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged excision/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Extensive barnacle colonization on outer lateral edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique deep secondary indentation on the right lobe trailing edge positioned approximately midway between the median notch and the lateral tip.
